metadata.title: Public Health Analytics-OS controlled disaggregation assertion model

claimTypes.label: Source-required
claimTypes.meaning: The cited source explicitly requires the dimension for this object.

claimTypes.label: System-available
claimTypes.meaning: The dimension is observed in a named, versioned system artefact applicable to this object.

claimTypes.label: Analyst-recommended
claimTypes.meaning: The dimension is analytically useful; no source or system availability claim follows.

dimensions.label: Social, caste, tribal or ethnic group

rules: Every assertion identifies one controlled dimension, claim type, status, evidence, applicability and review state.
Analyst recommendation never implies that a source requires or an operational system captures the dimension.
System availability requires an observed, named and versioned source artefact; portal or national implementation is not inferred.
Source-required remains empty unless explicit object-level evidence is available.
Exact legacy free text is preserved for audit even when no controlled dimension can be resolved.
Absence of an assertion means not evidenced in this release, not unavailable in the real-world system.
No person-level values or public bulk-download controls are introduced by this model.
